snippet.title: DEAD OR ALIVE 6 - Rachel Teaser
snippet.description:
Rachel the fiend hunter from the Holy Vigoor Empire returns to the DEAD OR ALIVE Cast soon! Rachel joins in on the Ninja Gaiden 15th Anniversary celebration with Momiji and is ready to take down anyone that stands in her way. Rachel is part of Season Pass 3 but can also be purchased separately on all platforms.

There will be costumes to unlock in game for her as well as new Command training, Combo Challenges and DOA Quests. Please make sure to check out all the playable modes with Rachel!
Debut set for Rachel will also be available which includes Happy Wedding Costume, Pirates of the 7 Seas Costume, Seaside Eden Costume, Summer Breeze Collection and Santa Bikini. 
DEAD OR ALIVE 6 is available now for purchase on PlayStation 4, Xbox One and Steam for PC 

https://teamninja-studio.com/doa6/uk/products.html
